manifest.build_scope: Frozen UI lab with UI source commit plus recorded baseline bootstrap/network inputs; later network-policy commit is not part of this binary.

build_input_snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency change. Rust bridge adds clear_selection for existing SelectState. Explicit native adapters, preference selector allocation/refresh and browser tests changed. Concurrent root network-policy work remains excluded.
build_input_snapshot.method: Frozen UI overlay base a3afc206f742f0a59da6e65d609ddf1df3c7326d plus 16 explicit live UI overrides (including sidebar_metal.h/mm), with committed own installer/stager hooks; concurrent network-policy changes excluded. Twenty-one prototype source hashes are matched to committed, live and staged inputs.

native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

build_scope: UI source commit with recorded frozen bootstrap/build tools from d23f232; current-main network policy excluded from this binary and acceptance.
contracts: The main tab/tree sidebar viewport uses Rust-owned extent, allocation, authoritative fractional offset, reveal and clamp in the opt-in backend. Views keeps bounded ScrollView sizing and its native path.

PanelViewport accepts the existing Rust-backed custom sidebar scrollbar. Its thumb/track/key/AX state and Metal display remain unchanged; both viewport backends expose the scrollbar through the adapter interface. Other callers keep their default scrollbar.

Main-sidebar native ScrollView subscriptions/synchronization are removed. Projection, workspace preview capture/reset and animation control consume the shared viewport and View adapter. Footer and palette scroll surfaces remain native.

The shared ownership/resize/shrink case checks actual sidebar host type, scrollbar and AX role, compact/wide bounds, reaching the bottom and revealing the first tab, workspace content collapse and return. The fractional projection case now routes an actual ScrollEvent through the sidebar Widget before checking exact fractional clip and native mouse hit testing.

Existing scrollbar thumb/track/key/AX, real-tab wheel/hit testing, workspace swipe/repeat, presented Metal animations, live tabs/folders/split and generic panel viewport oracles retain semantic assertions through the common interface.
No dependency, browser service, model/store/admission or persistence change. Native measurement, View/node identity, input/focus/AX/window/frame, bar and animation adapters remain.

initial_probe.note: Metal passed all 5 focused cases; Views passed the generic oracle but failed the new sidebar resize case because ScrollTo was issued while compositor impl bounds still reflected the preceding size (requested live maximum 590, observed offset 430). Native ui::Layer::SetScrollOffset documents this pre-commit resize limitation. The final fixture requires successful presentation of the new geometry before requesting the bottom position; production code was unchanged for this correction.

limits: Full automated acceptance does not establish complete functional/manual/release parity.
Footer and palette scrolling, remaining native control/node/container/input/window ownership still need migration.
Manual hardware trackpad, IME candidate windows, VoiceOver, global RTL, scale/theme and GPU recovery remain open.
No controlled CPU/GPU/drawable-presentation/input-latency or memory gain established.
Current-main combined network policy and final shipped dependency/license/notice acceptance remain outside the frozen UI lab checkpoint.

gpu_log_diagnostics.scope: Chromium compositor mailbox diagnostics remain in retained logs. The drag/width cases and full launchers succeeded; this checkpoint does not establish a diagnosis or resolution of these messages.
